en.d: Click your initials at the top-right, then select "Club Settings".
In Organisation Settings, enter your club's name.
Choose your timezone so dates and deadlines show correctly for your coaches.
Set your theme colours. "Primary" is your main brand colour, used across the admin and your coaches' experience.
Click to upload your logo (SVG, PNG or JPG), or drag and drop it. It replaces the placeholder across the platform.
Once your details, colours and logo are set, click "Update" to save.

en.doneD: Your club name, timezone, brand colours and logo are saved. You can update these from Club Settings at any time.
en.lead: For club admins. Add your club's name, timezone, brand colours and logo so the platform feels like yours.
